definitions.gloss: ride comfort; how comfortable a ride is
definitions.explanation: The quality of comfort experienced when riding in a vehicle.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{乗|の}り{心地|ごこち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This car has a comfortable ride.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乗|の}り{心地|ごこち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧だ。
examples.english: The ride quality of the shinkansen is excellent.

examples.japanese: {乗|の}り{心地|ごこち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a bicycle with a comfortable ride.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ (to ride) + ⟦{心地|ここち}→心地：12568_kokochi⟧ (feeling, sensation) → feeling while riding

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {乗|の}り{心地|ごこち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ / ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ (comfortable ride)
- {乗|の}り{心地|ごこち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (uncomfortable ride)
- {乗|の}り{心地|ごこち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ (a car with good ride quality)

RELATED ～{心地|ごこち} WORDS:
- ⟦{居心地|いごこち}→居心地：06634_igokochi⟧ (comfort of a place)
- ⟦{寝心地|ねごこち}→寝心地：07270_negokochi⟧ (sleeping comfort)
- ⟦{着心地|きごこち}→着心地：07269_kigokochi⟧ (wearing comfort)
- ⟦{使|つか}い{心地|ごこち}→使い心地：07271_tsukaigokochi⟧ (ease of use)

USAGE:
Applies to any vehicle: cars, trains, bicycles, motorcycles, etc. Often used in reviews and advertisements.
